description: Federal contract opportunities from SAM.gov — solicitations, presolicitations, sources-sought, and award notices — normalized into flat JSON. Each carries the notice id, title, solicitation number, posted date, type, set-aside, NAICS, place of performance, award (when present), a point of contact, and the sam.gov link. Leave the dates off for the recent feed; SAM caps a query window at one year.

naics.description: NAICS code filter, up to 6 digits, e.g. '541519'.

ptype.description: Procurement type: o solicitation, p presolicitation, a award, etc.

name: get_opportunities
title: Get federal contract opportunities (SAM.gov)
